findings.title: LineChart draws unclipped and ChartMath.Dashes is unbounded: one far off-plot point in a dashed range creates unbounded permanent Line regions
findings.locations: LibKa0s/WidgetsLineChart.lua:212 (dash loop), :236 (CreateLine), :362 (no clip), :369 (host yMin/yMax trusted); tests/test_widgets_linechart.lua:111
findings.evidence: Headless: Dashes(0,0,0,1e5) -> 14,286 dashes; Dashes(0,0,0,1e6) -> 142,858 dashes, 22 MB. In client each dash is a session-lifetime Line region (header :224). Not reached today: LootHistory (only consumer) derives y range from its own series (modules/TimelineModel.lua:475). No test draws a series point outside the domain.
findings.remediation: C-01: clip every series segment and marker rule to the plot rectangle before drawing (bounds region count by geometry); CHART_MINOR 2->3; add out-of-domain cases. Rejected: clamping input, capping Dashes alone, documenting as host duty. Ships in v1.71.0.

findings.title: Autocomplete hooks installed once per box die silently on a later SetScript; re-calling lib.Autocomplete cannot reinstall them
findings.evidence: hooked[box] stays true after a host/skin SetScript replaces the script and its HookScript wrappers, so the documented recovery never re-hooks. OnTextChanged replaced -> list never opens; OnEditFocusLost/OnHide replaced -> list stays up. API doc does not state scripts must be set before the call; only LootHistory's BrowserFilterBar.lua:426 comment does. Both adopters (LootHistory, BankLedger) set scripts first, so not reached today. Mock may not model SetScript clearing hooks (unverified).
findings.remediation: C-03: re-install hooks on every lib.Autocomplete call behind a per-box generation so stale hooks go inert; document the set-scripts-first precondition in the API doc; fix testkit/mock_base.lua (+tests/_kit mirror, kit revision bump) only if the mock does not drop hooks on SetScript.

findings.title: Chart hover does not resync on SetData/Render; every host must call ClearHover before repainting
findings.evidence: Documented (version-12.1.4.2.1-docs.md:1125-1129) but remedy is host code; LootHistory wrote ClearHover with a 3-line comment. Resize under resting cursor leaves crosshair at old pixel. A second host skipping the call shows stale tooltip values.
findings.remediation: C-02: make a data change (SetData/Render) re-arm the hover in the widget.

findings.title: Chart owns OnSizeChanged->Render, so a host rendering from its own layout pass may draw twice (unverified)
findings.evidence: When host re-anchor changes chart size, chart renders from its own script and again from the host's explicit Render call (possibly different height): double LTTB thinning, labels, region repaint per layout. Unmeasured; no chart perf scenario or Perf bucket.
findings.remediation: Deferred by the review: measure first (headless count of Render calls per TL:Layout in LootHistory's suite, or in-client capture); change the seam (e.g. opts.manualRender) only if the number justifies it.

findings.title: Autocomplete calls host provider and onPick unprotected, unlike the library's other host callbacks
findings.evidence: Other host callbacks in the Widgets major run under pcall with reported fallback (e.g. tooltipPlace, docs :750). A raising provider errors on every debounce, list never shows, no line names the widget. Only reached by a host whose provider raises; neither adopter known to.
findings.remediation: C-03: run provider and onPick under pcall, route a raise to geterrorhandler() once and close the list.

findings.title: ParseValue accepts nan/inf and the write seam stores them on an unbounded number row; clamp absorbs NaN only by argument order
findings.evidence: Lua 5.1: tonumber('nan'/'inf'/'1e400') -> nan/inf/inf. math.max(-100,0/0) -> -100 but math.max(0/0,-100) -> -nan, so order is load-bearing and unrecorded. Row with no min/max/validate stores the non-finite value; SV serialization unverified. Only via '/<slash> set <path> nan' on an unbounded row; none confirmed; WoW tonumber('nan') unverified.
findings.remediation: C-04: parseNumber rejects nan and +-inf with existing ERR_NUMBER before enum/clamp logic; add a comment recording why math.max(row.min, n) argument order matters; add tests in tests/test_slash_parse.lua. Not in Schema.Set (type-agnostic by design).

findings.title: owners/hooked weak-table comment claims entries are collected, which Lua 5.1 (no ephemerons) cannot do
findings.evidence: Comment says 'a box the host drops takes its entries with it', but the value (h.__box) strongly references its key, so entries are never collected. No runtime effect (client frames never collected).
findings.remediation: C-03: correct the comment.

findings.title: opts.maxRows accepts a non-integer, desynchronizing row count from list height
findings.evidence: maxRows=2.5 with 8 items draws 2 rows in a 2.5-row-tall list: visible empty half-row. Only a host passing fractional maxRows; LootHistory's SUGGEST_MAX presumed integer.
findings.remediation: C-03: floor maxRows.

findings.title: Autocomplete skin() rebuilds the backdrop on every render (unverified cost)
findings.evidence: SetBackdrop re-lays pieces and allocates a table per debounce tick that shows rows; only colors need to follow the box. Unmeasured. Every player typing in LootHistory/BankLedger search boxes.
findings.remediation: C-03: set the backdrop once and recolor per show.

findings.title: Chart default x labels use C-runtime English month abbreviation (%b) (in-client unverified)
findings.evidence: date('%d %b', x) uses C locale; LootHistory passes only formatY (grep -c formatX = 0). deDE/frFR players may see '07 Oct' on Timeline spans >= 1 day, if client date is C-locale (unverified).
findings.remediation: Library default unchanged; API doc states the default is C-locale English and localized hosts pass formatX. The actual fix is a LootHistory consumer task (pass formatX) - listed as follow-up, not executed in this bundle.
